ModMetaData.name: Auto Pharmacy – Doctors Give the Right Drug
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Doctors give the right drug to whoever needs it – automatically, by how serious the problem is.
- Every drug in the game is read once (vanilla and any mod): less pain, faster immunity, less bleeding, blood loss, consciousness, breathing, blood pumping, cures a named illness, rest, mood. - Every colonist is checked: pain, an illness that is winning the race against immunity, bleeding, blood loss, failing organs, low mood. - The best drug is chosen by how serious it is: mild problem → mild drug; addictive drugs only when life is in danger (setting). - Never twice: a drug whose effect is still running is not given again; overdose risk, teetotalers and your blocked drugs are respected. - Also injectors, serums and kits used on a pawn (healer serum and the like only when life is in danger). - Medical care level for tending (bandages, herbal, industrial, glitterworld) set by how serious it is – unless Pharmacist is installed, which does that. - The settings list every drug and what it does; untick any you do not want used. - Combat drugs: a drafted fighter with enemies close takes one combat drug (Go-juice, Wake-up …) – never with a chance of addiction, once per fight, can be switched off per colonist. - Regular use (1.3.0): prevention drugs (penoxycyline and the like) for everyone a little before the last dose runs out; a family plan button per adult colonist – no children (contraception given regularly) or children wanted (fertility drug) – whenever a mod adds such drugs. - Long-term troubles (1.3.0): bad back, cataract, frailty, old wounds – a drug that helps moving, hands or sight. - Mild drugs like beer for low mood or pain when they cannot start an addiction. - Recommended settings switch for new players. - Works under the Doctor work type.
